_comment: Pax AI runtime config. Hot-reloaded on mtime change (pax_ai/config.py). Defaults live in code; this file overrides them.
_feature_bus_comment: Required for the self-training edge loop. feature_bus.enabled=true starts passive snapshot/turn capture into pax-bus.db at Pax-AI process startup. outcomes.enabled=true labels mature ai_turns into trade_outcomes so calibration/replay can score forecasts. Restart Pax-AI after changing these flags; hot reload updates config values but does not start daemon threads that were disabled at boot.
_forecast_comment: Self-training research loop. forecast.enabled=true makes chat.py persist a structured <<PAX_FORECAST>> block (when Claude emits one) to the SQLite store at forecast.store_path. Capture is fire-and-forget; chat path never breaks on persistence failure. Outcomes still require feature_bus.enabled=true elsewhere for the trade_outcomes join to produce paired calibration rows.
